profile.headline: Software Architect and Engineer - ex Amazon Robotics, J&J Pharmaceuticals
profile.summary:
Experienced software professional in Cloud software, SaaS, robotics and algorithm implementation.

Experience managing teams and projects, especially in start-up and small-business environments.

Languages: Java, JavaScript, Scala, Octave, Matlab, Python, Assembly, C, C++, C# (.NET)

Specialties: AWS Cloud, interfacing to external systems.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked with CEO and CTO to design application requirements for new SAAS cloud platform, "OPUS", including: customer master data application, file manager application, message center application, audit application, B2B system application, and B2B "Extension" applications to interface with external ERP systems.

Architected and led development of B2B extension applications for interfacing the OPUS cloud platform with external ERP systems using AS2, SFTP, email and customizable JavaScript interfaces over http. Extensive use of AI in generating and testing application components.

positions.title: Technical Lead
positions.description:
Created application modules for pharmaceutical supply-chain traceability to comply with government regulations for US, India and Brazil, including rigorous automated tests. Rewrote significant reporting module to speed up data delivery to customers.

Architected and led development of backend IoT application to support barcode scanning of warehouse deliveries.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: North Reading, Massachusetts, United States · On-site
positions.description:
As an early employee at Kiva Systems, led the development of the map-translation component for the warehouse robotics movement subsystem, including the extension of those tools to multi-level warehouses using lifts.

After acquisition by Amazon Robotics, architected and developed tools for conversion of movement subsystem "snapshots" to a new journalling file system, enabling real-time replay of robotic movement to diagnose production issues after the fact. Architected the next-generation robotic control component for the movement subsystem using AWS technologies.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Algorithms · AWS DynamoDB · AWS S3 · Robotics · Real-time Control Systems

positions.title: Group Leader and Principal Developer
positions.description:
Architected and led the development of a suite of lab automation software for pharmaceutical startup. Included software controls for off-the-shelf robotic arm, as well as for three custom-made lab robotic machines - for dispensing micro-doses into vials, imaging vials, and analyzing crystalline properties using lasers.

Software manager after acquisition by J&J, where my team produced new experimental platforms for use at J&J sites in New Jersey and Belgium.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Robotics · .NET Framework · ASP.NET · Real-time Control Systems

positions.title: Business Owner
positions.description: Contract software developer for Telecom Sciences (real time telecoms OS, C), Chalksoft (animated educational games, Borland Delphi), Incorporated Technologies (PIC assembly language implementation of wireless mouse), Bio-Medical Instrumentation (machine vision, C, motor control, image analysis), Mitel Telecom (telecoms switch support, C++), and NCR Financial solutions (ATM development, C++).
positions.insights: Skills: Robotics · JavaScript · Embedded C · C++ · Assembly Language

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Architected and led development of firmware for two product families of weighing instrumentation, using assembly language and C. Developed firmware for novel digital loadcell prototype, incorporating patented micrometry device from a Cambridge University entrepreneur.
positions.insights: Skills: Robotics · Embedded C · Assembly Language · Digital Signal Processors · Real-time Control Systems
